sources.title: GitHub - blazux/qwen3.8-Flash-DGX: recipe for running Qwen3.8-Flash ...
sources.snippet: Run Qwen3.8-Flash-Next — a ~176B-parameter model (125B main + 51B n-gram, 6B active) — on one NVIDIA DGX Spark / ASUS GX10 with vLLM, at full prefill speed, with MTP speculative decoding, working prefix caching, deterministic greedy decoding, and up to 500k tokens of context.
